description:
Goal

Make CallableConstructionOwner::construction mean one thing: an owned first-class wrapper construction. Direct-only callable producers must not publish an empty construction that final packaging later has to reject by rejoining publication boundaries.

Signal

The fz-k22.31 proof found a direct-only local producer with construction: Some, members=[], carrier=Absent, and no boundary publications. BackendProgram correctly contains zero wrappers only because package_backend_construction_wrappers separately reconstructs publication eligibility. A genuinely first-class uncalled named reference carries a nonempty construction and publication and must remain wrapped.

Strategy

Prove direct-only, uncalled first-class, captured, opaque, and mixed direct/public controls at the position-owned CallableConstruction product. Clarify construction Some/None at the product producer so only first-class wrapper authority produces Some. Delete the final publication-boundary re-join/filter and any now-dead empty-construction handling. Consume exact positioned owners directly; do not infer eligibility from layouts, types, targets, or root inventories.

Acceptance

Direct-only owners expose construction=None and create no wrapper; public owners expose exact nonempty constructions and create wrappers without a second eligibility filter. Existing direct/public interpreter/JIT/AOT behavior, replacement/order tests, full library suite, and strict clippy pass.
title: Clarify callable construction as first-class wrapper authority
